title: 第28章 导演约歌

第28章 导演约歌-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“找我约歌？”

“对。”

中午，上戏602宿舍。

人模狗样的陈贺给自己倒了一杯水。

魏沐看着他把水喝完才慢慢开口：“接着说。”

“是这样。”

拿了把椅子坐下，陈贺说起后面发生的事情。

“韦正导演想找你写歌，作为我们这部剧的主题曲。”

“为什么是我？不应该找专业歌手？”

“不知道，反正他点名要你，他看过你之前唱歌的视频。”

点名要我？

想了想《爱情公寓》目前的情况，大概知道什么意思。

特么的，不管是现在，还是未来，大学生都是廉价劳动力！！

“我不去。”

“你干嘛不去啊！！”

陈贺急了。

这是好事啊！！

电视剧找你写歌，以后电视剧播出，你的歌还能红。

两全其美。

“别啊，魏哥。我都跟导演说咱们俩是兄弟，包在我身上。”

“魏哥....魏哥...魏..”

魏沐越听脸色越不对劲。

说魏不说哥，文明你我他。

你要么喊哥，要么喊沐哥，魏哥听起来怪怪的。

“行了，你小子到底什么情况？已经拿下角色？”

“还没有，两天以后还有一场面试。”

“那你说个蛋。”

陈贺舔着脸笑，其实他对这件事心里没有底。

不说别的，曾小贤可是男主角，他这辈子还没有演过男主角。

非要算的话，只有之前拍的MV男主角。

所以，陈贺非常重视这次机会。

如果魏沐写的歌得到导演和编剧的认可，那么自己拿下男主角的概率会大大增加。

“你是这个意思？”

“不然呢？你就当帮哥们一把，我和你不一样，你长得帅，还会写歌，以后一定会红！！”

“我呢？就我这个长相。在上戏只能排末尾。”

说着说着，陈贺的眼神充满了期待和激动。

“我不能确定《爱情公寓》是否大火，但这是一次机会。我必须考虑这是不是我此生仅有的机会！！”

魏沐惊讶的看着他。

怎么突然燃起来了？

不过话说回来，如果陈贺没有曾小贤这个角色，他肯定不会达到原时空的高度。

"Are you looking for a song date with me?"

"Yes."

At noon, go to dormitory 602.

Chen He, who looked like a dog, poured himself a glass of water.

Wei Mu watched him finish the water before slowly speaking: "Go on."

"That's right."

Taking a chair and sitting down, Chen He talked about what happened next.

"Director Wei Zheng wants to ask you to write a song as the theme song for our drama."

"Why me? Shouldn't I hire a professional singer?"

"I don't know. Anyway, he asked you by name. He has seen the video of you singing before."

Want me by name?

After thinking about the current situation of "Love Apartment", I probably know what it means.

What’s more, college students are cheap labor no matter now or in the future!!

"I'm not going."

"Why don't you go!!"

Chen He was anxious.

This is a good thing!!

TV dramas ask you to write songs. After the TV dramas are broadcast, your songs will still be popular.

Best of both worlds.

"No, Brother Wei. I told the director that we are brothers, so I'll take care of it."

"Brother Wei...Brother Wei...Wei..."

The more Wei Mu listened, the more uncomfortable his expression became.

Talking about Wei, not talking about brother, you and I are civilized.

You can either call me Brother or Brother Mu. Brother Wei sounds weird.

"Okay, what's going on with your kid? Have you already won the role?"

"Not yet. There is an interview in two days."

"Then tell me something."

Chen He licked his face and smiled. In fact, he had no idea about this matter.

If nothing else, Zeng Xiaoxian is the leading actor. He has never played a leading actor in his life.

If I have to count, only the male protagonists in the MVs shot before.

Therefore, Chen He attaches great importance to this opportunity.

If the song Wei Mu writes is recognized by the director and screenwriter, then his chances of winning the leading role will be greatly increased.

"Is that what you mean?"

"Otherwise? Just be a helper. I am different from you. You are handsome and can write songs. You will definitely become famous in the future!!"

"What about me? With my looks, I can only be ranked last in the show."

As he spoke, Chen He's eyes were full of anticipation and excitement.

"I'm not sure if "Love Apartment" is a big hit, but this is an opportunity. I have to consider whether this is the only opportunity in my life!!"

Wei Mu looked at him in surprise.

Why did it suddenly burst into flames?

But having said that, if Chen He didn't have the role of Zeng Xiaoxian, he would definitely not reach the heights of the original time and space.
